units: <cite ref="Sotah 48a:19">Sot. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>זמרי גברי … פ׳</he> when men sing, and women respond, it is licentiousness.

<cite ref="Sotah 26b:14">Ib. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ בעלמא היא ופ׳ וכ׳</he> this is merely an act of obscenity (not real adultery), and has the Law forbidden a wife to her husband because of an act of obscenity?; <cite ref="Yevamot 55b:9">Yeb. 55ᵇ</cite>.
B. Mets. 91ᵃ ואפי׳ משום פ׳ ליכא and it is not even considered an obscenity; a. e.—Trnsf. a bold, licentious woman.

<cite ref="Megillah 12b:5">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>מכדי פ׳ הואי וכ׳</he> she (Vashti) being a licentious woman … why did she refuse to appear?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1049:7">Yalk. Esth. 1049</cite> (not <he>פ׳ הוא</he>).
